*Sanidassanattika, Pītisahagataduka* (Patthana 16.85) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Within the complex combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this section analyzes conditional relations by synthesizing the triad of visible phenomena (*sanidassanattika*) with the dyad of phenomena accompanied by rapture (*pītisahagataduka*) [SuttaCentral]. No translations or dedicated secondary literature entries are recorded for this individual section in the provided dossier.
